''See also: [[void key Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A void key is a rare and valuable spatial tool that provides its holder with access to a private, internal pocket dimension. This personal space functions as an extra-[[spatial vault]] used for storing various items, ranging from everyday necessities like food and [[water]] to specialized equipment, weapons, [[constructs]], and even living beings. The internal environment of a void key is often described as complete darkness or an endless abyss, though some variations may contain different characteristics. Accessing the contents typically involves opening a [[portal]] or doorway in midair, which can vary in size from a small basket to something as large as a barn or a closet. While the key is generally accessible only to its owner, it can be compromised if stolen or if someone manages to reach inside while it is open. The ability to create these objects is difficult; even [[Sages]] are considered the weakest beings capable of making them. They exist in various grades and sizes, and their stability can be influenced by the user's concentration or specific types of [[madra]]. In certain environments where spatial manipulation is restricted, using a void key can become significantly more difficult.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|A void key provides its holder with access to a private space for void storage. While sages are the weakest beings capable of creating these items, they may potentially contain treasures belonging to [[Akura Malice]]. Both [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]] possess [[void keys]], with [[Lindon]] specifically using his to store items such as carp steaks.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|During the events of [[wintersteel|Wintersteel]], a void key manifested in the center of a room, and [[Charity]] was later seen reaching into one to retrieve a chair. [[Lindon]] demonstrated the ability to pull various items from his own void key, including his armor plates, and it was noted that such objects can even be used to contain a [[cloudship]]. While [[Timaias Adama|Adama]] does not possess one, [[Mercy]] carries a void key around her neck, and [[Charity]] also maintains her own. [[Lindon]] eventually plucked a void key from [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]'s neck after his own had slid open.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Various individuals utilize [[void keys]] for different purposes throughout the journey. [[Yerin]] possesses a void key that lacks sufficient capacity to hold all of her belongings, though she eventually learns how to force it open. [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] employs a void key specifically for storage needs. Meanwhile, [[Lindon]] uses his own void key to summon a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] and utilizes the space within it to keep [[Orthos]] [[safe]] while flying.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Orthos]] possesses a void key, which was later used by [[Lindon]] to store [[Penance arrowheads|Penance arrows]]. While inside the Array, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] found that he was unable to open his own void key. During a confrontation, [[Yerin]] utilized a void key to release [[Underlord Remnants]], and another void key opened in the vicinity of [[Orthos]]. Although these objects can hold [[Archlord-level natural treasures]], [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] planned to use his specifically to keep the [[Sage]]'s [[Remnant]]. Additionally, [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] carries a gemstone that possesses the sensation of a very deep void key.}}
